conclusions: Body emission reduced retained functional acceptance from 8/8 to 5/8 and full acceptance from 7/8 to 4/8, with 54.1% more reported model tokens.
All eight pairs were provider-stable; only three matched realized compute and no pair met the predeclared qualifying gain.
All first generated candidates passed finite private cases; four body and two control candidates required quality repair. Three body quality repairs regressed functional behavior.
One accepted body run recovered an interface rejection before generating its first candidate; this is not an accepted quality-only code repair.
The narrower body edit surface and extra scaffold/ref instructions may contribute to the regression; these hypotheses are not causally isolated by this epoch.
diagnosis.nextGeneralCorrection: Compose existing guarded source-bound refactor selection with live-generated candidates on fresh unseeded objectives; compare unchanged complete-file repair, require actual proposal exposure and original-state quality, and do not credit pre-feedback differences. No new cognitive layer or task-specific solution.

limitations: Four same-author domains with two declared repeats, not an official benchmark or independent E5 replication.
Finite private correctness does not certify every possible input or requested algorithm constraint.
Body emission confines helper placement; control can edit the original complete file. Prompt/schema differences are retained.
Actual token/call/verifier accounting is observed, not model FLOPs or total host CPU.
Source files and raw reasoning are not retained; no exact failed statement or retrospective diagnosis is fabricated.
Existing Node R3 execution is not a proven hostile-code or network sandbox; production authority remains unavailable.
Success on these tasks does not establish the active goal of >=80% across all agreed frontier benchmarks.

epoch.limitations: Body arm preserves the sole-function scaffold and cannot move helpers outside that function; full-file arm has the original file edit envelope. No broader coding or reasoning claim.

report.hypothesis: Source-bound function-body serialization preserves observed interfaces and reduces emission failure or improves fresh full acceptance under unchanged downstream parser, native model, V3 quality, verifier, authority and shared caps. The body arm has a narrower scaffold-preserving edit surface; actual compute and prompt differences are reported. No broad cognition or default promotion follows from implementation tests.
report.falsification: No reproducible gain in quality-accepted repairs or reduced repair cost on fresh tasks at matched realized compute, or any weakened gate.
